repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 15000 ms period for both the sustain window and the cycle body. This causes the hold counter to increment only every 15 seconds, reaching the 30-second threshold at 30000 ms. At that exact moment, the candidate checks `n >= 2` (which is false) and breaks before emitting the action. The IR requires the sustain to complete (30s) and then execute the cycle body (15s) twice. The candidate must use a 100 ms period for the sustain logic and a 15000 ms period for the cycle body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100 to correctly count the 30-second sustain window. Restructured script to separate the sustain check (using a hold counter) from the cycle body (using `delay(15 SEC)` between calls). Removed the erroneous `n >= 2` guard at the sustain threshold which caused premature termination.
